title: Parquet flooring installation
description: New parquet floor laid in a private residence at Orchid Park Condominium. Sub-floor levelled, planks installed and edged, then sanded and finished with a clear varnish system to suit residential use.
alt: Newly installed parquet floor at Orchid Park Condominium

title: Residential flooring installation
description: Flooring installation in a landed home at Namly Avenue. Existing floor removed, sub-floor prepared, and replacement floor finish laid through living and bedroom spaces ahead of homeowner occupancy.
alt: Flooring installation at a Namly Avenue residence

title: Tile flooring installation
description: Tile flooring works at a Phen Geck Avenue property. Existing finish removed, screed checked and corrected where needed, then porcelain tiles laid and grouted to the homeowner specification.
alt: Tile flooring installed at a Phen Geck Avenue property

title: Vinyl roll flooring
description: Vinyl sheet flooring laid at a place of worship. Sub-floor cleaned and primed, vinyl roll laid with seams welded, and edges trimmed to give a continuous surface for high-traffic congregational use.
alt: Vinyl sheet flooring at Fisherman of Christ Church

title: Vinyl plank flooring
description: Vinyl plank installation in a residential interior. Sub-floor checked for moisture and flatness; planks click-locked and trimmed at perimeters with skirting reinstated.
alt: Installed vinyl plank flooring in a residential interior

title: Outdoor decking
description: Outdoor decking works at Changi Rise. Existing deck assessed, defective boards replaced and deck refinished to match the homeowner brief.
alt: Outdoor deck installation at Changi Rise

title: Condominium A&A renovation
description: Internal renovation works at a Parc Olympia unit. Demolition, partition, finishes and selected M&E coordination carried out as a phased fit-out package.

title: Retail LED lighting works
description: Retail lighting works at a Paragon mall storefront. Display and ceiling lighting reworked to brand specification with coordination on mall fit-out hours.
alt: LED lighting works at the Longchamp store in Paragon

title: Mobile retail kiosk fit-out
description: Mobile-phone retail unit fit-out at Parkway Parade. Display joinery, signage and lighting installed within mall fit-out windows.
alt: Mobile retail unit fit-out at Parkway Parade

title: Office fit-out
description: Commercial office fit-out — partitioning, ceiling, lighting and floor finishes installed to tenant specification.

title: Waterproofing and painting at height
description: Waterproofing repair and external painting on an elevated facade at Ruby Lane. Sealant cut-out and renewal followed by protective coating, executed with a written work-at-height plan.
alt: Waterproofing and painting works at Ruby Lane

title: Condo external waterproofing
description: External waterproofing works at Parc Olympia condo. Vertical access used to reach defective sealant joints; cut-out, prime and renewal carried out with project-specific access arrangement.
alt: External waterproofing at Parc Olympia condominium

title: Vertical waterproofing repair
description: Vertical waterproofing — joint cut-out, primer and sealant renewal at an external facade. Access selected to suit the site geometry; method statement reviewed before works.
alt: Vertical waterproofing repair on an external facade

title: Awning works
description: External awning installation at Pasir Panjang. Frame fabrication, hoisting and fix-down to the host structure with coordination on site access during works.
alt: Awning installation works at Pasir Panjang

title: Metal welding works
description: On-site metal welding and fabrication works at an Eunos property. Steel members cut, welded and finished to suit the project brief, with site protection and supervision.
alt: Metal welding works at an Eunos site

title: Metal railing installation
description: Metal railing installation at a place of worship. Posts set, top rail and infill installed and finished, coordinated with congregation use and access.
alt: Metal railing installation at St Mary Church

title: Skylight installation
description: Skylight framing and glazing installed over an internal court. Glass type and frame selected to suit the design loading; sealant and flashing detailed for weather-tightness.
alt: Skylight installation over an internal courtyard

title: Staircase glass railing
description: Frameless glass staircase railing — tempered laminated panels set into base channel with stand-off fixings. Edge treatment and panel sizing coordinated with the consultant.
alt: Frameless glass railing on an internal staircase
